_readme: Editable site content. Change text here, save, rebuild. Fields ending in _TODO describe what to add; an empty value is simply hidden on the site. Most other text can also be edited live in the admin (Content > Text).

countries._readme: Set enabled to true to show a country again across the site (USA section, university explorer, contact form, footer). The country data itself lives in src/lib/scholars-data.ts.
